title: Voice replies come before I finish

message.text: We're doing both. The mic will hold what you say until you've been quiet for about 2.5 seconds, then send it as one prompt. The assistant will also be told to stay silent when your words look unfinished, and never to ask you to continue. One minion is building it now, and I'll report here when it's done.

Fixed. The card mic now keeps what you say and sends it as one prompt only after you've been quiet for 2.5 seconds, and it keeps waiting as long as you're still talking. The assistant is also told to stay silent on words that look cut off and never to ask you to continue. That rule goes live when Servex restarts, which I'm doing now.
